name: Bleed More, Bodymore
source:
HORROR IS WHAT HAPPENS WHEN EVIL OVERTAKES THE HEART.

Joey’s a mechanic. One night, she receives a call from her best friend, asking for his car to be picked up from the infamous body dumping grounds of Baltimore: Leakin Park. When she arrives, there’s little more around than a stalled-out car and a couple of ravens, so she leaves only with the car. Back at the body shop, it doesn’t take long for the smell of rot to permeate the trunk. Inside? A corpse. Is it her friend? And if not, then where is he?

Something isn’t right in Baltimore. It’s not just the feeling that someone is always watching from the city’s abandoned buildings... Her search for her friend reveals something much worse hiding under the city. 

[From [url=https://kirkpattiecake.itch.io/bleed-more-bodymore-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当邪恶占据心灵时，就会发生恐怖。

乔伊是一名机械师。一天晚上，她接到她最好的朋友的电话，要求从巴尔的摩臭名昭著的尸体倾倒场：利金公园接他的车。当她到达时，周围除了一辆熄火的汽车和几只乌鸦之外什么也没有，所以她只带着车离开了。回到车身修理厂，没过多久，腐烂的气味就弥漫在后备箱里。里面？一具尸体。是她的朋友吗？如果不是，那么他在哪里？

巴尔的摩有些不对劲。这不仅仅是一种总有人在城市废弃建筑中注视的感觉……她在寻找朋友的过程中发现了隐藏在城市之下的更糟糕的事情。
